mapper.sql: select contact_id, account_id, currency, booked_total, inflight_total, refund_total, net_clv, acquisition_cost, pltv_12m, pltv_36m, tier, churn_risk_score, visit_count_12m, avg_visit_amount, jsonb_build_object( 'implant', COALESCE(implant_total, 0), 'ortho', COALESCE(ortho_total, 0), 'restorative', COALESCE(restorative_total, 0), 'preventive', COALESCE(preventive_total, 0), 'pediatric', COALESCE(pediatric_total, 0) )::text as by_treatment, first_visit_at, last_visit_at, next_recall_due_at, (select c.original_source from crm_contact c where c.contact_id = crm_patient_value.contact_id) as original_source, calculated_at, del_flag from crm_patient_value
mapper.select: select contact_id from crm_contact where contact_id is not null
select contact_id from crm_contact where account_id = #{accountId}
select contact_id from crm_contact where account_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_patient_value ( contact_id, account_id, tenant_id, currency, booked_total, inflight_total, refund_total, net_clv, acquisition_cost, pltv_12m, pltv_36m, tier, churn_risk_score, visit_count_12m, avg_visit_amount, implant_total, ortho_total, restorative_total, preventive_total, pediatric_total, first_visit_at, last_visit_at, next_recall_due_at, calculated_at, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{contactId}, #{accountId}, #{tenantId}, #{currency}, #{bookedTotal}, #{inflightTotal}, #{refundTotal}, #{netClv}, #{acquisitionCost}, #{pltv12m}, #{pltv36m}, #{tier}, #{churnRiskScore}, #{visitCount12m}, #{avgVisitAmount}, COALESCE((#{byTreatment}::jsonb ->> 'implant')::numeric, 0), COALESCE((#{byTreatment}::jsonb ->> 'ortho')::numeric, 0), COALESCE((#{byTreatment}::jsonb ->> 'restorative')::numeric, 0), COALESCE((#{byTreatment}::jsonb ->> 'preventive')::numeric, 0), COALESCE((#{byTreatment}::jsonb ->> 'pediatric')::numeric, 0), #{firstVisitAt}, #{lastVisitAt}, #{nextRecallDueAt}, #{calculatedAt}, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET account_id = EXCLUDED.account_id, tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, booked_total = EXCLUDED.booked_total, inflight_total = EXCLUDED.inflight_total, refund_total = EXCLUDED.refund_total, net_clv = EXCLUDED.net_clv, acquisition_cost = EXCLUDED.acquisition_cost, pltv_12m = EXCLUDED.pltv_12m, pltv_36m = EXCLUDED.pltv_36m, tier = EXCLUDED.tier, churn_risk_score = EXCLUDED.churn_risk_score, visit_count_12m = EXCLUDED.visit_count_12m, avg_visit_amount = EXCLUDED.avg_visit_amount, implant_total = EXCLUDED.implant_total, ortho_total = EXCLUDED.ortho_total, restorative_total = EXCLUDED.restorative_total, preventive_total = EXCLUDED.preventive_total, pediatric_total = EXCLUDED.pediatric_total, first_visit_at = EXCLUDED.first_visit_at, last_visit_at = EXCLUDED.last_visit_at, next_recall_due_at = EXCLUDED.next_recall_due_at, calculated_at = EXCLUDED.calculated_at
